nodes.label: Graphify Workflow
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions should begin with scoped Graphify query, path, or explain operations so the relevant subgraph is inspected before broader reports or raw source.

nodes.label: Scoped Subgraph Navigation
nodes.rationale: Scoped query results are preferred because they are usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw search output.

nodes.label: Dirty Graph Output Tolerance
nodes.rationale: Dirty graphify-out files are expected after hooks or incremental updates and should not prevent use of the graph.

nodes.label: Graph Update After Code Changes
nodes.rationale: Running graphify update after code changes keeps the AST-derived knowledge graph current without API cost.
